Knowhow / Commerce / A subscription dashboard people check on purpose
COMMERCE · CASE STUDY

Has anybody already built a dashboard for managing subscriptions and renewals?

Making recurring payments visible, predictable and easy to change.

The question

How do you show recurring charges so customers feel in control instead of surprised?

The approach

Lead with what renews next and what it will cost. Group the rest by cadence, and put pause, skip and cancel one tap away from each row.

The tradeoff

Easy cancellation can lower short-term retention, but it reduces chargebacks and support tickets and earns trust that brings people back.

What to take with you

Watch saves from pause and skip, not just cancellations. The best retention lever is a renewal nobody regrets.
